the political opportunity structures in Bangka and East Belitung are different and this has led to the failure of the anti offshore tin mining movement in Bangka and the success of the movement in East Belitung.
the political opportunities for the movement to succeed were not available in the case of Bangka, but they were available in the case East Belitung.

the anti offshore tin mining movement succeeded in East Belighton, an area where the tin mining industry has been historically important, but failed in Bangka, an area where offshore tin mining has been a recent phenomenon, because in the former, the political opportunity structures were more open, the elite was fragmented and there were influential allies who supported the movement, while in the latter, the elite was united and used a clientelistic political settlement mechanism to co opt local communities within the tin mining extraction chain.

how political opportunity structures, political settlement, and the political participation of movements affect the democratisation process.
